name: Affinity
summary: An Affinity relationship CRM: companies, people and opportunities with their field data, lists and saved views, relationship strength, and notes.

api_key.description: an Affinity API key from Settings > Manage Apps (needs the Generate an API key permission); it reads as its user

notes: Every call pins API version 2026-09-17 with the X-Affinity-Api-Version header.
Field data comes back only for the fields named in fieldIds or fieldTypes; get the ids from the fields calls. Several values repeat the key (fieldIds=a&fieldIds=b).
Paging is a cursor: follow pagination.nextUrl, or pass its cursor.
Limits: 900 requests per user per minute; monthly calls by plan (Scale and Advanced 100k, Enterprise unlimited); 429 when hit. Calls to API v1 and v2 share the pool.

endpoints.name: Identify the key
endpoints.summary: The key's user, organization and API permissions.

endpoints.name: List companies
endpoints.summary: Companies with their non-list field data, page by page.

cursor.description: The cursor from pagination.nextUrl of the previous page.

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 100; 100 when omitted.

fieldIds.description: Field ids to return data for, each sent as its own fieldIds; find them with the fields calls. Without fieldIds or fieldTypes no field data comes back.

fieldTypes.description: Field categories to return data for, each sent as its own fieldTypes: enriched, global, relationship-intelligence. Not with fieldIds.

endpoints.name: Search companies
endpoints.summary: Companies matching a keyword, field filters and sorts.

fieldIds.description: Field ids to return data for. Not with fieldTypes.

fieldTypes.description: Field categories to return data for: enriched, global, relationship-intelligence. Not with fieldIds.

cursor.description: The cursor from pagination.nextUrl of the previous page.

limit.description: Items per page, 1 to 100; 100 when omitted.

totalCount.description: Add the total match count; costs more.

search.description: {"term": text of 3+ characters, "fieldIds": [more fields to match]}; the term always matches name and primary domain (or name and emails).

filters.description: A filter group: {"operator": "and"|"or", "filters": [{fieldId, valueType, operator, value}]}, nestable, up to 50 items per group.

notes: A POST that only searches; it changes nothing. Beta.
Needs the Export All Organizations directory permission. With no body it lists all companies.
